<!--
Template shipped with the zfbehavior package (inst/skills/intraplate-vc-qc/).
Do not edit the analysis code below for a specific study -- put every
study-specific choice in intraplate-vc-qc.yml and render with:

  quarto render intraplate-vc-qc.qmd --execute-params intraplate-vc-qc.yml

This document only calls exported zfbehavior functions. See
inst/skills/CONVENTIONS.md for the run-folder / naming / manifest rules.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(zfbehavior)

p <- params
skill <- "intraplate-vc-qc"

stop_param <- function(msg) {
  stop("intraplate-vc-qc parameter error: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
}
as_chr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) character(0) else unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
or_default <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
is_unset <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) != 1 || !nzchar(trimws(x)) || identical(x, "CHANGE_ME")
}

if (is.null(p$run_label) || !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", p$run_label)) {
  stop_param("`run_label` is required (letters, digits, '-', '_').")
}
upstream_run <- sub("/+$", "", as_chr(p$upstream))
if (length(upstream_run) != 1) {
  stop_param("`upstream` must list exactly one behavior-endpoints run folder.")
}
if (is_unset(p$response_label)) stop_param("`response_label` is required.")

outlier_degree <- as.numeric(or_default(p$outlier_degree, 3))
if (length(outlier_degree) != 1 || !is.finite(outlier_degree) || outlier_degree <= 0) {
  stop_param("`outlier_degree` must be one positive number.")
}
similarity_threshold <- p$similarity_threshold
if (!is.null(similarity_threshold)) {
  similarity_threshold <- as.numeric(similarity_threshold)
  if (length(similarity_threshold) != 1 || !is.finite(similarity_threshold) ||
      similarity_threshold <= 0 || similarity_threshold > 1) {
    stop_param("`similarity_threshold` must be a number in (0, 1], or null.")
  }
}
title_cols <- or_default(as_chr(p$title_cols), "plate_id")
pdf_width <- as.numeric(or_default(p$pdf_width, 15))
pdf_height <- as.numeric(or_default(p$pdf_height, 10))

# Quarto may deliver a yml list of maps as a data.frame or a list of lists.
as_plate_table <- function(x, what) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  get_col <- function(nm) {
    if (is.data.frame(x)) {
      v <- x[[nm]]
      if (is.null(v)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(x)) else as.character(v)
    } else {
      vapply(x, function(e) if (is.null(e[[nm]])) NA_character_ else as.character(e[[nm]]), "")
    }
  }
  out <- data.frame(plate_id = get_col("plate_id"), reason = get_col("reason"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (nm in names(out)) {
    if (any(is.na(out[[nm]]) | !nzchar(trimws(out[[nm]])))) {
      stop_param(paste0("every `", what, "` entry needs a non-empty `", nm, "`."))
    }
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(out$plate_id)) stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` lists a plate more than once."))
  out
}
exclude_tbl <- as_plate_table(p$exclude_plates, "exclude_plates")
keep_tbl <- as_plate_table(p$keep_plates, "keep_plates")
both <- intersect(exclude_tbl$plate_id, keep_tbl$plate_id)
if (length(both) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("plate(s) in both `exclude_plates` and `keep_plates`: ", paste(both, collapse = ", ")))
}

project_root <- normalizePath(p$project_root, mustWork = TRUE)
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- function(object, ext) {
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(skill, "__", p$run_label, "__", object, ".", ext))
}
# CONVENTIONS.md section 2: every table saved to outputs/ is a tibble,
# including tables one level inside a saved list / result object.
save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  as_tbl <- function(v) if (is.data.frame(v) && !inherits(v, "tbl_df")) tibble::as_tibble(v) else v
  x <- as_tbl(x)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    cls <- class(x)
    x[] <- lapply(x, as_tbl)
    class(x) <- cls
  }
  saveRDS(x, path)
}
# A previous pass's manifest / decisions must not survive a failed re-render.
for (f in c(out_path("manifest", "yml"), out_path("plate-decisions", "rds"))) {
  if (file.exists(f)) file.remove(f)
}
md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))

has_plotly <- requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
has_reactable <- requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)
show_table <- function(df, page_size = 15) {
  if (has_reactable) {
    reactable::reactable(df, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
                         defaultPageSize = page_size, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE)
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
type_labels <- c(
  total_distance = "Total distance",
  distance_change_shift = "Distance change / shift",
  movement_similarity = "Movement similarity"
)
```

## Run

- Skill: `intraplate-vc-qc`
- Run label: **`r p$run_label`**
- Baseline outliers: Tukey fence, degree **`r outlier_degree`**
- Low movement similarity: `r if (is.null(similarity_threshold)) "not applied" else paste0("vehicle-control median < ", similarity_threshold)`
- zfbehavior version: `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior"))`
- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

## Upstream

Exactly one `complete` `behavior-endpoints` run. Its import run (for the
vehicle-control traces) and the plates its own QC upstream runs already
excluded are read from its manifest (`CONVENTIONS.md`, section 6).

```{r}
#| label: upstream

read_manifest <- function(run) {
  dir <- file.path(project_root, run)
  f <- list.files(file.path(dir, "outputs"), pattern = "__manifest\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) != 1) {
    stop("intraplate-vc-qc: no unique manifest found in ", file.path(dir, "outputs"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  m <- yaml::read_yaml(f)
  if (!identical(m$status, "complete")) {
    stop("intraplate-vc-qc: upstream run `", run, "` has status `", m$status,
         "`, not `complete`. Resolve it first (", m$status_reason, ").", call. = FALSE)
  }
  m$.run <- run
  m$.manifest_file <- f
  m
}
check_md5 <- function(m, pattern, what) {
  outs <- data.frame(path = vapply(m$outputs, `[[`, "", "path"),
                     md5 = vapply(m$outputs, `[[`, "", "md5"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rel <- outs$path[grepl(pattern, outs$path)]
  if (length(rel) != 1) {
    stop("intraplate-vc-qc: upstream manifest of `", m$.run, "` lists no ", what, " output.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  file <- file.path(project_root, m$.run, rel)
  now <- md5(file)
  drift <- !identical(now, outs$md5[outs$path == rel])
  if (drift) {
    warning("Upstream ", what, " md5 differs from its manifest (", m$.run, "): the run was ",
            "modified after it completed. Confirm with the user before using these results.",
            call. = FALSE)
  }
  list(file = file, rel = file.path(m$.run, rel), md5 = now, drift = drift)
}

ep <- read_manifest(upstream_run)
if (!identical(ep$skill, "behavior-endpoints")) {
  stop("intraplate-vc-qc: upstream must be a behavior-endpoints run (found `", ep$skill, "`).",
       call. = FALSE)
}
ep_up_skills <- vapply(ep$upstream, function(u) as.character(u$skill), "")
imp_run <- sub("/+$", "", as.character(ep$upstream[[which(ep_up_skills == "dataset-import-qc")]]$run))
imp <- read_manifest(imp_run)
endpoints_in <- check_md5(ep, "__endpoints\\.rds$", "endpoints.rds")
combined_in <- check_md5(imp, "__combined\\.rds$", "combined.rds")

prior_excl <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0), qc_run = character(0))),
  lapply(ep$plates_excluded_by_qc, function(e) data.frame(
    plate_id = as.character(e$plate_id), reason = as.character(e$reason),
    qc_run = as.character(e$qc_run), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
))

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  upstream = c(ep$.run, imp$.run),
  skill = c(ep$skill, imp$skill),
  used_for = c("endpoints checked", "vehicle-control traces and plate labels"),
  status = c(ep$status, imp$status),
  md5_matches_manifest = c(!endpoints_in$drift, !combined_in$drift)
), row.names = FALSE, caption = paste0(
  "Upstream runs. Plates excluded before the endpoints run (already absent): ", nrow(prior_excl), "."
))
if (nrow(prior_excl) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(prior_excl, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = "Plates already excluded upstream (not in the endpoints; context only).")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load

endpoints <- readRDS(endpoints_in$file)
combined <- readRDS(combined_in$file)
missing_cols <- setdiff(title_cols, names(combined))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`title_cols` not in the import data: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
plate_info <- unique(as.data.frame(combined)[combined$plate_id %in% endpoints$plate_id,
                                             unique(c("plate_id", title_cols)), drop = FALSE])
if (anyDuplicated(plate_info$plate_id)) stop_param("`title_cols` are not constant within each plate.")
plate_info$plate_label <- do.call(paste, c(lapply(title_cols, function(cc) as.character(plate_info[[cc]])), sep = "@"))
rownames(plate_info) <- NULL

unknown_dec <- setdiff(c(exclude_tbl$plate_id, keep_tbl$plate_id), plate_info$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_dec) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`exclude_plates`/`keep_plates` list unknown plate_id(s) (not in the endpoints): ",
                    paste(unknown_dec, collapse = ", ")))
}

endpoint_order <- unique(as.data.frame(endpoints)[, c("endpoint_type", "endpoint")])
endpoint_order <- endpoint_order[order(match(endpoint_order$endpoint_type, names(type_labels))), , drop = FALSE]
types <- intersect(names(type_labels), endpoint_order$endpoint_type)
sim_endpoints <- endpoint_order$endpoint[endpoint_order$endpoint_type == "movement_similarity"]
if (!is.null(similarity_threshold) && length(sim_endpoints) == 0) {
  stop_param("`similarity_threshold` is set, but the endpoints have no movement_similarity endpoint (set it to null).")
}

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates = nrow(plate_info),
  vc_wells = nrow(unique(endpoints[endpoints$is_vehicle_control, c("plate_id", "well_id")])),
  endpoints = nrow(endpoint_order),
  movement_similarity_endpoints = length(sim_endpoints)
), caption = "Endpoints checked (from the behavior-endpoints run).")
```

## Vehicle-control baselines

Each plate's **baseline** for an endpoint is `denom`, the median of its
vehicle-control wells -- the value the plate's endpoints are normalized
against (scale: log10(distance + 1) for total distance, AUC for distance
change/shift, raw 0-1 similarity for movement similarity). For each
endpoint, the baselines of all plates are compared with a Tukey fence,
`[Q1 - k*IQR, Q3 + k*IQR]` with k = `r outlier_degree`
(`detect_behavior_vc_baseline_outliers()`); plates outside it are flagged
(`low`/`high`).

```{r}
#| label: baselines

baseline <- detect_behavior_vc_baseline_outliers(endpoints, outlier_degree = outlier_degree)
baseline$plate_label <- plate_info$plate_label[match(baseline$plate_id, plate_info$plate_id)]
baseline$below_similarity_threshold <- if (is.null(similarity_threshold)) {
  FALSE
} else {
  baseline$endpoint_type == "movement_similarity" & baseline$denom < similarity_threshold
}
distribution <- summarize_behavior_vc_distribution(endpoints, level = "plate", outlier_degree = outlier_degree)
distribution$n_below_similarity_threshold <- vapply(distribution$endpoint, function(e) {
  sum(baseline$below_similarity_threshold[baseline$endpoint == e])
}, 1L)
ord <- match(distribution$endpoint, endpoint_order$endpoint)
distribution <- distribution[order(ord), , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-distribution
#| tbl-cap: "Distribution of plate baselines per endpoint (one value per plate). Fences use the degree above."

dist_show <- as.data.frame(distribution)
num <- vapply(dist_show, is.double, TRUE)
dist_show[num] <- lapply(dist_show[num], signif, 4)
show_table(dist_show[, setdiff(names(dist_show), "level")], page_size = 25)
```

### Distributions

One point per plate; red = flagged outlier. Interactive in this report
(hover for plate identity); static versions with labels are in the QC PDF.
`r if (!is.null(similarity_threshold)) paste0("The dashed line in the movement-similarity plot is the threshold (", similarity_threshold, ").") else ""`

```{r}
#| label: baseline-plots

baseline_plots <- lapply(types, function(ty) {
  b <- baseline[baseline$endpoint_type == ty, , drop = FALSE]
  b$endpoint <- factor(b$endpoint, levels = endpoint_order$endpoint[endpoint_order$endpoint_type == ty])
  b <- b[order(b$endpoint), , drop = FALSE]
  b$endpoint <- as.character(b$endpoint)
  b$is_outlier <- b$is_outlier | b$below_similarity_threshold
  n_flag <- length(unique(b$plate_id[b$is_outlier]))
  pl <- plot_behavior_vc_baseline(
    b, label_col = "plate_label",
    title = paste0(type_labels[[ty]], ": plate vehicle-control baselines (n = ",
                   length(unique(b$plate_id)), " plates; ", n_flag, " flagged)"),
    y_label = "Vehicle-control baseline (denom)", jitter_alpha = 0.35
  )
  if (ty == "movement_similarity" && !is.null(similarity_threshold)) {
    pl <- pl + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = similarity_threshold, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red")
  }
  pl
})
names(baseline_plots) <- types
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-baselines
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5

if (has_plotly) {
  widgets <- lapply(baseline_plots, function(pl) {
    pl$layers <- Filter(function(l) !inherits(l$geom, "GeomText"), pl$layers)
    suppressWarnings(plotly::ggplotly(pl, tooltip = "text"))
  })
  htmltools::tagList(widgets)
} else {
  for (pl in baseline_plots) print(pl)
}
```

## Flagged plates

A plate is **flagged** when any endpoint baseline is a fence outlier
`r if (!is.null(similarity_threshold)) paste0("or any movement-similarity baseline is below ", similarity_threshold) else ""`.
The consensus table counts, per plate, how many endpoints flagged it: a
plate flagged by many endpoints (or by related endpoints, e.g. the same
phase) is more likely a real vehicle-control problem than one flagged by a
single endpoint.

```{r}
#| label: flags

flag_rows <- baseline[baseline$is_outlier | baseline$below_similarity_threshold, , drop = FALSE]
n_endpoints <- nrow(endpoint_order)
flagged_ids <- unique(flag_rows$plate_id)
plate_flags <- data.frame(plate_id = flagged_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
plate_flags$plate_label <- plate_info$plate_label[match(plate_flags$plate_id, plate_info$plate_id)]
plate_flags$n_flagged_endpoints <- vapply(flagged_ids, function(id) {
  sum(flag_rows$plate_id == id & flag_rows$is_outlier)
}, 1L)
plate_flags$n_endpoints <- rep(n_endpoints, length(flagged_ids))
for (ty in types) {
  plate_flags[[paste0("n_", ty)]] <- vapply(flagged_ids, function(id) {
    sum(flag_rows$plate_id == id & flag_rows$is_outlier & flag_rows$endpoint_type == ty)
  }, 1L)
}
plate_flags$flagged_endpoints <- vapply(flagged_ids, function(id) {
  r <- flag_rows[flag_rows$plate_id == id & flag_rows$is_outlier, , drop = FALSE]
  r <- r[order(match(r$endpoint, endpoint_order$endpoint)), , drop = FALSE]
  paste0(r$endpoint, " (", r$direction, ")", collapse = ", ")
}, "")
plate_flags$low_similarity <- vapply(flagged_ids, function(id) {
  r <- flag_rows[flag_rows$plate_id == id & flag_rows$below_similarity_threshold, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(r) == 0) "" else paste0(r$endpoint, " = ", signif(r$denom, 3), collapse = ", ")
}, "")
plate_flags$decision <- ifelse(
  plate_flags$plate_id %in% exclude_tbl$plate_id, "exclude",
  ifelse(plate_flags$plate_id %in% keep_tbl$plate_id, "keep", "UNRESOLVED")
)
plate_flags$reason <- ifelse(
  plate_flags$plate_id %in% exclude_tbl$plate_id,
  exclude_tbl$reason[match(plate_flags$plate_id, exclude_tbl$plate_id)],
  ifelse(plate_flags$plate_id %in% keep_tbl$plate_id,
         keep_tbl$reason[match(plate_flags$plate_id, keep_tbl$plate_id)], "")
)
plate_flags <- plate_flags[order(-plate_flags$n_flagged_endpoints, plate_flags$low_similarity == "",
                                 tolower(plate_flags$plate_label), method = "radix"), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(plate_flags) <- NULL

decisions <- plate_info[, c("plate_id", "plate_label")]
decisions$flagged <- decisions$plate_id %in% flagged_ids
decisions$n_flagged_endpoints <- ifelse(
  decisions$flagged, plate_flags$n_flagged_endpoints[match(decisions$plate_id, plate_flags$plate_id)], 0L
)
decisions$low_similarity <- decisions$plate_id %in% plate_flags$plate_id[plate_flags$low_similarity != ""]
decisions$decision <- ifelse(
  decisions$plate_id %in% exclude_tbl$plate_id, "exclude",
  ifelse(decisions$plate_id %in% keep_tbl$plate_id, "keep",
         ifelse(decisions$flagged, "UNRESOLVED", "keep (not flagged)"))
)
decisions$reason <- ifelse(
  decisions$plate_id %in% exclude_tbl$plate_id,
  exclude_tbl$reason[match(decisions$plate_id, exclude_tbl$plate_id)],
  ifelse(decisions$plate_id %in% keep_tbl$plate_id,
         keep_tbl$reason[match(decisions$plate_id, keep_tbl$plate_id)], "")
)
decisions$excluded <- decisions$decision == "exclude"
decisions <- decisions[order(!decisions$flagged, -decisions$n_flagged_endpoints,
                             tolower(decisions$plate_label), method = "radix"), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(decisions) <- NULL

unresolved <- decisions$plate_id[decisions$decision == "UNRESOLVED"]
kept_unflagged <- intersect(keep_tbl$plate_id, decisions$plate_id[!decisions$flagged])

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  plates = nrow(decisions),
  flagged_plates = length(flagged_ids),
  flagged_by_baseline_outlier = sum(plate_flags$n_flagged_endpoints > 0),
  flagged_by_low_similarity = sum(plate_flags$low_similarity != ""),
  flagged_plate_endpoint_pairs = sum(flag_rows$is_outlier),
  excluded = sum(decisions$excluded),
  unresolved = length(unresolved)
), caption = "Flag summary.")
if (length(kept_unflagged) > 0) {
  cat("Note: `keep_plates` lists plate(s) that are not flagged (no decision needed): ",
      paste(kept_unflagged, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-consensus
#| tbl-cap: "Consensus: one row per flagged plate, most-flagged first. n_<type> = flagged endpoints of that type."

if (nrow(plate_flags) > 0) {
  show_table(plate_flags, page_size = 20)
} else {
  cat("No plate flagged.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-flag-detail
#| tbl-cap: "Every flagged plate x endpoint, with the baseline and the endpoint's fences."

if (nrow(flag_rows) > 0) {
  fd <- as.data.frame(flag_rows[, c("plate_id", "plate_label", "endpoint_type", "endpoint", "denom",
                                    "lower_fence", "upper_fence", "direction", "below_similarity_threshold")])
  num <- vapply(fd, is.double, TRUE)
  fd[num] <- lapply(fd[num], signif, 4)
  show_table(fd, page_size = 20)
}
if (nrow(exclude_tbl) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(decisions[decisions$excluded, c("plate_id", "plate_label", "flagged", "reason")],
               row.names = FALSE, caption = "Plates excluded by the user.")
}
```

## QC PDF

Pages 1-`r length(types)`: plate-baseline distributions per endpoint type
(flagged plates in red, labelled); then, for each flagged plate, its
vehicle-control well traces from the import run (`plot_raw_responses_pages()`,
`level = "well"`, labels `VC(n_kept/n_total)`), in consensus-table order, to
support the keep/exclude decision.

```{r}
#| label: qc-pdf

qc_pdf <- out_path("qc", "pdf")
grDevices::pdf(qc_pdf, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height)
for (pl in baseline_plots) print(pl)
n_trace_pages <- 0L
if (length(flagged_ids) > 0) {
  segs <- lapply(ep$method$segments, function(s) seq(as.numeric(s[[1]]), as.numeric(s[[2]])))
  d_flag <- combined[combined$plate_id %in% flagged_ids & combined$keep_well, , drop = FALSE]
  d_flag$plot_title <- paste0(
    plate_info$plate_label[match(d_flag$plate_id, plate_info$plate_id)], " | flagged: ",
    plate_flags$n_flagged_endpoints[match(d_flag$plate_id, plate_flags$plate_id)], "/", n_endpoints,
    ifelse(plate_flags$low_similarity[match(d_flag$plate_id, plate_flags$plate_id)] != "", " + low similarity", "")
  )
  d_flag$panel_key <- factor(d_flag$plate_id, levels = plate_flags$plate_id)
  wc <- count_wells_by_dose(
    combined[combined$plate_id %in% flagged_ids, , drop = FALSE],
    group_cols = c("plate_id", "is_vehicle_control", "concentration")
  )
  pages <- plot_raw_responses_pages(
    d_flag, group_cols = "panel_key", segments = segs, level = "well",
    wells = "vehicle_control", response_label = p$response_label,
    well_counts = wc, title_col = "plot_title"
  )
  for (pg in pages) {
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(pg)
  }
  n_trace_pages <- length(pages)
}
invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
n_pdf_pages <- length(baseline_plots) + n_trace_pages

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  pdf = qc_pdf, pages = n_pdf_pages, distribution_pages = length(baseline_plots),
  flagged_plates_with_vc_trace_pages = length(flagged_ids)
), caption = "QC PDF written.")
```

## Status and outputs

```{r}
#| label: status

if (length(unresolved) > 0) {
  status <- "needs_review"
  status_reason <- paste0(
    length(unresolved), " flagged plate(s) need a decision: ", paste(sort(unresolved), collapse = ", "),
    ". Inspect the consensus table, the baseline distributions and the plates' vehicle-control traces ",
    "(QC PDF), then list each in `exclude_plates` or `keep_plates` with a reason, and re-render."
  )
} else {
  status <- "complete"
  status_reason <- paste0(
    length(flagged_ids), " flagged plate(s) resolved; ", sum(decisions$excluded),
    " plate(s) excluded, ", nrow(decisions) - sum(decisions$excluded), " kept."
  )
}
```

**Status: `r status`.** `r status_reason`

```{r}
#| label: save

save_rds(baseline, out_path("baseline-outliers", "rds"))
save_rds(distribution, out_path("distribution", "rds"))
save_rds(plate_flags, out_path("plate-flags", "rds"))
outputs <- c(out_path("baseline-outliers", "rds"), out_path("distribution", "rds"),
             out_path("plate-flags", "rds"), qc_pdf)
if (identical(status, "complete")) {
  # Downstream-facing: written only once every flagged plate is decided.
  save_rds(decisions, out_path("plate-decisions", "rds"))
  outputs <- c(outputs, out_path("plate-decisions", "rds"))
}

to_entries <- function(tbl) lapply(seq_len(nrow(tbl)), function(i) as.list(tbl[i, c("plate_id", "reason")]))
manifest <- list(
  skill = skill,
  run_label = p$run_label,
  status = status,
  status_reason = status_reason,
  rendered_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
  zfbehavior_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior")),
  upstream = list(list(
    run = ep$.run, skill = ep$skill,
    manifest = file.path(ep$.run, "outputs", basename(ep$.manifest_file)), status = ep$status
  )),
  import_run = imp$.run,
  inputs = list(
    list(path = endpoints_in$rel, md5 = endpoints_in$md5, md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !endpoints_in$drift),
    list(path = combined_in$rel, md5 = combined_in$md5, md5_matches_upstream_manifest = !combined_in$drift)
  ),
  outputs = lapply(outputs, function(f) list(path = f, md5 = md5(f))),
  method = list(
    baseline = "denom = vehicle-control median per plate x endpoint (behavior-endpoints)",
    outlier_fence = paste0("Tukey fence across plates per endpoint, degree ", outlier_degree),
    outlier_degree = outlier_degree,
    similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
    similarity_rule = if (is.null(similarity_threshold)) "not applied" else
      paste0("flag if any movement_similarity baseline < ", similarity_threshold)
  ),
  plates_excluded_upstream = lapply(seq_len(nrow(prior_excl)), function(i) as.list(prior_excl[i, ])),
  summary = list(
    n_plates = nrow(decisions),
    n_endpoints = n_endpoints,
    n_flagged = length(flagged_ids),
    n_flagged_by_baseline_outlier = sum(plate_flags$n_flagged_endpoints > 0),
    n_flagged_by_low_similarity = sum(plate_flags$low_similarity != ""),
    n_flagged_plate_endpoint_pairs = sum(flag_rows$is_outlier),
    n_unresolved = length(unresolved),
    n_excluded = sum(decisions$excluded),
    n_qc_pdf_pages = n_pdf_pages
  ),
  flagged_plates = sort(flagged_ids),
  # Downstream skills drop exactly these plates (CONVENTIONS.md section 6).
  excluded_plates = to_entries(exclude_tbl),
  kept_flagged_plates = to_entries(keep_tbl[keep_tbl$plate_id %in% flagged_ids, , drop = FALSE]),
  parameters = p[setdiff(names(p), c("exclude_plates", "keep_plates"))]
)
yaml::write_yaml(manifest, out_path("manifest", "yml"))

knitr::kable(data.frame(output = c(outputs, out_path("manifest", "yml"))),
             caption = "Files written by this run.")
```
